name: 01-icone
prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing / identity-preserve.
Create ONE finished Google Play listing icon for the existing Simvio Receptor application. Square canvas 1024x1024, intended final downscale to 512x512.
Input image 1 is the OFFICIAL approved Simvio white/lime symbol on petrol background. This is a locked existing brand asset, NOT an inspiration for designing a new logo. Preserve its exact distinctive silhouette, horizontal proportions, circular lime center, four rounded horizontal extensions, white ring, and negative spaces. Do not invent, simplify, retype, mirror, rotate or redesign any part of the logo.
Generate the entire finished icon as one image: flat full-bleed solid official petrol #073E42 background all the way to every edge. Place only the official existing white/lime symbol optically centered, roughly 70% canvas width, retaining its original aspect ratio. Match lime #C6F36A. Crisp premium restrained brand design. NO wordmark, NO text, NO new logo, NO border, NO rounded outer corners, NO drop shadow, NO 3D, NO gradient, NO texture, NO glow. Do not show the original reference rectangle: adapt canvas to square with the locked mark. One standalone square icon, no contact sheet, no mockup, no collage.

name: 02-banner
prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset: ONE final Google Play feature graphic for Simvio Receptor, landscape 1024x500 pixels (aspect ratio exactly 2.048:1). Generate at 2048x1000 if needed, composition must fit this ratio without cropping.
Inputs: image 1 is official Simvio petroleum/lime wordmark, locked existing brand artwork. Preserve its actual shape and lettering; it is NOT a prompt to invent a logo. Image 2 is the existing application's visual style reference ONLY; do NOT use its embedded logo or pricing.
Art direction: sophisticated Brazilian software brand, editorial typography, generous negative space, restrained polished illustration, no collage or contact sheet. All artwork generated as one unified image. Solid very pale mineral #F3F7F3 background with a subtle broad pale petrol arc at far right. Left 60%: modest official existing wordmark at top; below, large bold Plus Jakarta Sans ExtraBold headline in #073E42, left aligned, 3 compact lines: "Seu Android." / "Receptor de" / "verificações." Final punctuation lime #C6F36A. Smaller Plus Jakarta Sans Medium subtitle below: "Conecte. Receba. Acompanhe." 
Right 35%: elegant conceptual single white rounded message tile with a minimal petrol outline SMS bubble, text "SMS recebido" and a lime circle with petrol check, accompanied by a single gentle curved lime route suggesting reception. This is conceptual marketing illustration, not a fake app screenshot. No device or phone frame. Avoid tiny UI details. Keep all wordmark, text and key illustration within middle 84% width and middle 76% height, minimum 55px margins at final resolution. Use only official petrol #073E42, lime #C6F36A, mineral #F3F7F3, white and muted petrol #3D6467. Faithful Plus Jakarta Sans letterforms. Preserve existing logo, don't typeset the logo with a font. No calls to action, no badges, no pricing, no ranking, no extra wording, no watermarks. One standalone landscape banner.

name: 02-banner-revisao
prompt: Edit this finished Simvio feature graphic with ONE targeted correction. Preserve the entire composition, exact existing official wordmark top left, all typography, all words and layout, pale mineral background, and right SMS received bubble. REMOVE ONLY the small standalone Simvio-like symbol situated between the headline and the bubble, because it is redundant branding. Also remove the connecting lime curved line attached to this small symbol. Replace that small region with the same continuous pale mineral background and its existing subtle pale arc. Keep right bubble and check unchanged. Do not add any replacement symbol. The single official top-left wordmark must remain identical to input. Keep entire image ratio exactly 1024:500 (2.048:1), all content away from edges. No other changes.

name: 03-fundo-conectar
prompt:

This is background artwork only: the actual app screenshot will be added later. Style reference is the attached final Simvio brand banner, follow its restrained editorial aesthetic and Plus Jakarta Sans typography.
Full bleed solid official petrol #073E42 backdrop, very subtle wide tonal arc at far right bottom in #0B4F54. At top, in the first 220px of a 1080x1920 canvas, set exactly this headline in white Plus Jakarta Sans ExtraBold, large and perfectly legible, centered on TWO lines: "Conecte seu" / "Android." Final dot in lime #C6F36A. At bottom in last 100px above 50px safe margin, centered two lines in white Plus Jakarta Sans Medium: "Leia o QR do painel ou" / "digite o código de pareamento." Large enough to read at listing size. Keep huge middle region entirely empty and uniformly petrol (from y=260 to y=1760): a real screenshot will occupy x=115 to965 and y=275 to1790. No frames, no cards, no placeholder rectangles, no shadows, no fake screenshot, no mockup, no phone, no QR. Do not draw a logo. No new symbol, no badges, no calls to download, no watermarks. Single coherent generated artwork, NOT a collage or contact sheet. Limit artwork to typography in header/footer and restrained edge accent. Exact text with correct Portuguese accents.
